attributes.context: The clause is paragraph 3.5 in Article 3 of the 1993-1997 Guild CBA, located after provisions identifying covered employees and protected work and before Article 4 on guild and agency shop.

extraction_text: 3.5 New Equipment: Notice will be given to the Union of any major equipment or process change at least 90 days prior to implementation if a reduction in force is anticipated affecting regular employees. In addition, the employer will provide training assistance to any regular employee displaced after the operation of Article 27. Where practicable, such training will be provided to develop skills required for other classifications covered by this contract.

attributes.context: The surrounding text concerns VDT/RSI safety, including baseline ophthalmological examinations, lead aprons for pregnant employees, healthful work practices supported by a VDT/RSI Committee, and equipment intended to alleviate RSI.
